gaps.reason: the authoritative Table 3 value set is not implemented and has no ICD-10-CM codes, so its diagnosis and problem branches are omitted

gaps.valueSet: Rule 6: generic rabies-antibody test plus cerebrospinal-fluid specimen type
gaps.reason: SEM_V1 has no specimen-type predicate and the HL7 CSF value set is not implemented; the coded CSF-specific test-name alternative is modeled, while the generic-antibody-plus-specimen branch is omitted

gaps.valueSet: Rule 7: rabies immune globulin administered AND rabies vaccine administered
gaps.reason: SEM_V1 has medication evidence but no immunization predicate, so the conjunction cannot be represented safely and Rule 7 is omitted

gaps.valueSet: Rules 8-10: laboratory test orders and code-less test-panel value sets
gaps.reason: SEM_V1 lab evidence does not distinguish orders from completed observations, so coded order-name alternatives use labTestInValueSet; all three authoritative panel value sets have no codes and their branches are omitted

gaps.valueSet: Rule 11: serum Lyssavirus antibody AND no history of rabies vaccination
gaps.reason: the authoritative source marks the entire rule inoperable because no-history-of-vaccination cannot be implemented; SEM_V1 also lacks specimen-type and negative immunization-history predicates, so Rule 11 is omitted
the authoritative snapshot marks these reporter types not implemented in RCKMS; SEM_V1 does not carry reporter-source or death-certificate cause/contributing-condition evidence
